Type B: Test Issue

UI Updated

Navigation was redesigned from a sidebar to a top navigation bar. An old test that clicks a sidebar link for "Settings" will fail because the sidebar no longer exists.

Failure Scenario: ui_changed

The navigation structure was completely redesigned. Settings was previously accessed via a sidebar menu link.

  • Old UI: Left sidebar with navigation links including a "Settings" link element
  • New UI: Top navigation bar with tabs (Dashboard, Settings, Profile, Notifications)
  • Old test behavior: Clicks .sidebar-nav a[href="#settings"] or a sidebar link labeled "Settings"
  • Expected fix: Click the "Settings" tab in the top navigation bar instead
